question: What was the total cash balance on 2014-03-31?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_cash_balances.Cash) AS cash_balance FROM atlas.dwd.fact_cash_balances AS fact_cash_balances INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_cash_balances.SK_DateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.DateValue = CAST('2014-03-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: Cash balance is a kind of account balance (can be negative for margin)
Balance is recorded per brokerage account
